confirmedIssues.title: Missing security evidence is classified as measured secure/insecure state
confirmedIssues.mechanism: Latest omits absent signals and can successfully return {}. Truthy {} passes hasData/latest gates: summary becomes Unsecure; missing Sentry/HomeLink/guest becomes Inactive/Away/Disabled; doorClosed(null) returns true; unknown windows count as open/venting. Historical locked=null renders danger/Unlocked despite its unknown filter label. Any nonempty unrecognized window string also falls through to Open.
confirmedIssues.sourceReproduction: Without any network, consider an accepted latest payload {} or a history row with locked:null, doorState:null and null windows. Trace existing branches: posture lock says Unknown, history lock says Unlocked, doors say Closed, aggregate windows say 4 open/venting, summary says Unsecure. Individual windows say Unknown. Expected: distinguish absent facts/partial posture from measured open/closed/on/off. A payload with locked:true and four Closed windows but no doorState can conversely produce Secure with unknown doors.
confirmedIssues.reproductionExecution: NOTRUN; deterministic source-branch proof, not a mounted or live reproduction.
confirmedIssues.existingTestConstraint: helpers.test.ts:19-24 currently pins nullish doors as closed. A narrow owner must explicitly update this policy with additive regression coverage, not merely restyle it.

confirmedIssues.title: Live chip asserts freshness for retained, offline or empty latest payloads
confirmedIssues.mechanism: Chip visibility is latest truthiness, not source trust. Page forwards fatalError only, so a cached response remains truthy after refresh failure/paused fetch; chip still pulses Live beside a canonical retained/offline notice. Latest has no created_at field, so the summary observation timestamp is not supplied by this endpoint.
confirmedIssues.sourceReproduction: Keep previously returned latest data and set query error/isError or fetchStatus='paused'. deriveDataState returns stale/cached with fatalError=null; LiveVehicleState still receives the old object and renders Live. A successful {} also activates the chip. Expected: cached/blocked/unknown state, never fabricated signal-observation age.
confirmedIssues.needs: Pass existing DataState trust to the live renderer and reuse canonical freshness/status presentation. Observation time remains unknown unless a separately owned backend contract actually supplies it.

confirmedIssues.title: Last lock change selects an earlier event from ascending server history
confirmedIssues.mechanism: Server orders events ts ASC, folder appends without reversal, handler preserves order, and page only filters it. findLastLockChange stops at the first differing adjacent pair and returns events[i-1].createdAt. The summary labels that as the latest observed lock transition.
confirmedIssues.sourceReproduction: Ascending rows A@10:00 locked=false, B@11:00 locked=true, C@12:00 locked=false yield A@10:00 from the helper, while the last observed transition is C@12:00. Even descending input would need an explicit ordering policy; current backend output establishes the defect.
confirmedIssues.reproductionExecution: NOTRUN; source-derived trace, not runtime test execution.
confirmedIssues.needs: Narrow helper ordering/timestamp fix with ascending, descending, missing-state and no-transition cases; retain documented fallback behavior and source rows.

confirmedIssues.title: Sentry day buckets and axis labels do not honor workspace calendar semantics
confirmedIssues.mechanism: Daily grouping slices the source ISO timestamp's first ten characters, ignoring the vehicle/workspace timezone used for range bounds. Axis then parses that YYYY-MM-DD as UTC and formats it in browser timezone with no locale/tz option, allowing a west-of-UTC previous-day label.
confirmedIssues.sourceReproduction: An event at 2026-10-11T01:00:00Z belongs to Oct10 in America/Los_Angeles but is bucketed Oct11. The date-only bucket 2026-10-11 represents UTC midnight to new Date, which the same west-of-UTC browser labels Oct10. Different browser/workspace zones further disagree. Expected: explicit workspace-local bucket day and a date-label formatter that does not shift calendar-only identities.
confirmedIssues.reproductionExecution: NOTRUN; source and ECMAScript date-only semantics, no browser execution.
confirmedIssues.needs: Narrow domain bucket/axis formatting fix using existing timezone/locale helpers; retain all samples and on/off series identities.

confirmedIssues.title: Security twin still displays untranslated Sentry and lock tooltips
confirmedIssues.mechanism: The page mounts VehicleTwin interactive. SecurityOverlay uses Tooltip content='Sentry mode active' and locked ? 'Locked' : 'Unlocked', even though their Button aria-labels are localized. These are visible strings, not signal values or DOM identities.
confirmedIssues.sourceReproduction: With Sentry=true or a known lock state and a non-English locale, inspect/focus the overlay control: configured tooltip content remains English while its accessible name/inspection alternatives use t().
confirmedIssues.needs: Existing shared VehicleTwin owner localizes the two tooltip payloads with existing keys and scoped coverage. No catalog campaign or page-local duplicate twin.

confirmedIssues.sourceReproduction: Cold history data=undefined, fetchStatus='paused', isPending=true, isLoading=false, isError=false gives history=[] and error=null; table/chart/timeline use no-events empty content.
